title: Mcp Security Tool Poisoning
motto: Tool descriptions land in the model's context verbatim. Malicious servers embed hidden instructions that users never see. Research in 2025-2026 from Invariant Labs, Unit 42, and an arXiv study published March 2026 measured attack-success rates above 70 percent on frontier models and about 85 percent against state-of-the-art defenses under adaptive attacks. This lesson names the seven concrete attack classes and builds a tool-poisoning detector you can run in CI.
